OUTBOUND_SOURCE_TRANSPORT.meaning: The exact embedded Slang program plus END_OF_SOURCE is statically traceable into the outbound socket send without executing the exploit.

facts.relation: void function arguments inside do/while are skipped by allocation liveness scan
forged_header reuses vec_slot storage and is later consumed as vec
forged vec data=0 and huge size makes scribble equivalent to *(int64_t *)(idx*8) += delta
puts@GOT is adjusted toward system and /bin/sh is later passed to puts/system

limitations: Cycle-14 does not yet infer these target-side semantics automatically from the Slang language
official writeup truth is retained for later first-divergence work and is not converted into runtime observation

required_relations: module literal -> local concatenation -> encode -> sendall
forbidden_shortcuts: do not infer arbitrary write from the function name scribble alone
do not infer GOT hijack merely because /bin/sh or puts appears in a payload
do not execute the Python exploit or embedded Slang program
do not treat a dynamic send expression as a literal payload

unknown: automatic Slang AST/semantic parsing is not implemented in this cycle
runtime slot reuse is not observed by GDB/pwndbg in this cycle
the exact generated C and resulting ELF are not reconstructed by PwnCraft in this cycle
